fact: On 28 November 2024 the Ministry of Finance launched the first deployment phase of the SIGB, covering revenue (tax, customs, domain) and spending phases from commitment to payment, at the DGD, DGTC, DGB and DGI, with generalisation to all administrations by 2027.
title: Finances : lancement de la 1e phase de déploiement du Système Intégré de Gestion Budgétaire (SIGB)
